html.hero.title: “Generate electricity from the water on your land”
html.hero.quote: The richer our entrepreneurs are, the more prosperous our people will be and the more powerful our state. The success of an entrepreneur is the success of our whole nation.

text.MINI GES — sug'orish kanallari bo'yida m: MINI GES — design, construction and sale of small hydropower plants on irrigation canals. Ulug'nor HPP (600 kW) and Baliqchi HPP (1,000 kW).
text.MINI GES — o'z yeringizdagi suvdan elekt: MINI GES — electricity from the water on your land
text.Mini-GES loyihalash, qurish va sotish. U: Design, construction and sale of small hydropower plants. Ulug'nor HPP (600 kW) has been running since 2024; Baliqchi HPP (1,000 kW) starts in October 2026.
text.MINI GES: gorizontal turbinalar montaji: MINI GES: installing the horizontal turbines
text.Sug'orish kanallari bo'yida mini-GES loy: We design, build and hand over turnkey small hydropower plants on irrigation canals. Water is taken from the canal, passes through the turbine and flows back into the canal.
text.Birinchi stansiyamiz tarmoqqa tok berib: Our first plant is already feeding the grid; the second starts at the end of October 2026.
text.Ikkala stansiyamiz ham tarmoqqa tok beri: Both of our plants are feeding the grid.
text.Baliqchi GES ishga tushishiga qolgan vaq: Time left until Baliqchi HPP starts
text.Biz suv oqib turgan joyni elektr manbaig: We turn flowing water into a source of electricity. A river, stream or canal flows day and night, needs no fuel and refills every year. We measure the flow, design the plant, install the equipment and hand over a working hydropower plant, turnkey.
text.biri 2024-yildan ishlab turibdi, biri ya: one running since 2024, one being completed
text.yildan beri Ulug'nor GES tarmoqqa tok be: is when Ulug'nor HPP started feeding the grid — one of the first private small hydropower plants in Uzbekistan
text.kVt·soat toza elektr yiliga, ikki stansi: kWh of clean power a year, both plants together
text.xonadonning yillik ehtiyojiga teng elekt: households — their yearly electricity needs (at 2,200 kWh per year)
text.Kanaldan olingan suv tok beradi va yana: Water from the canal makes power and flows back into the canal
text.Mavjud sug'orish kanali bo'yida suv qabu: An intake is built on the bank of an existing irrigation canal. Steel gates divert part of the flow into a new channel, while the main canal keeps working as usual.
text.Kanal yonidan 400 metr uzunlikda yangi o: A new 400-metre channel is dug along the canal and lined with concrete. Its slope is gentler than the canal's, so a height difference (head) builds up in front of the plant.
text.Stansiya binosida ikkita gorizontal gidr: The powerhouse holds two horizontal turbine-generator units. The flow spins the turbine runner, turning the energy of moving water into mechanical rotation.
text.Turbina valiga ulangan generator aylanis: A generator on the turbine shaft turns rotation into electric current. A transformer steps the voltage up to grid level.
text.Suv qaytadi, tok tarmoqqa ketadi: Water goes back, power goes to the grid
text.Turbinadan o'tgan suv chiqish o'zani orq: After the turbine, the water returns to the same canal through a tailrace, so not a drop is lost for irrigation. The power goes to the grid or directly to a consumer.
text.Har bir stansiya alohida yuridik shaxs s: Each plant runs as a separate legal entity. We designed and built both from scratch, just as we would build one for you.
text.O'zbekistondagi birinchi xususiy mini-GE: One of the first private small hydropower plants in Uzbekistan. Since September 2024 it has been feeding the grid steadily, proving the quality of our work every day.
text.Ulug'nor GES ishga tushganidan beri ishl: Energy produced by Ulug'nor HPP since launch (estimate)
text.Har yili 2 100 t ko'mir yoqilmaydi, 4 00: Every year 2,100 t of coal are not burned and 4,000 t of CO₂ are not emitted
text.Oktyabr oxirida ishga tushadi: Starts at the end of October
text.Xitoylik hamkorlar bilan qurilgan ikkinc: Our second plant, built with Chinese partners.
text.Qurilish yakuniy bosqichda, ishga tushir: Construction is in its final stage; the launch is days away.
text.2026-yil oktyabr oxirida ishga tushirild: Launched at the end of October 2026.
text.Har yili 3 500 t ko'mir yoqilmaydi, 6 70: Every year 3,500 t of coal are not burned and 6,700 t of CO₂ are not emitted
text.1,6 MVt kichik ko'rinadi. Lekin har yili: 1.6 MW looks small. But every year:
text.Ikki stansiya birgalikda yiliga 13,9 mln: Together the two plants produce 13.9 mln kWh of clean power a year, replacing energy that would otherwise come from burning coal or gas.
text.CO₂ atmosferaga chiqmaydi: of CO₂ kept out of the air
No smoke, ash or harmful gases. The plant runs on the flow of water alone.
text.Suv kanalga qaytadi, sug'orishga zarar y: The water returns to the canal, so irrigation is not affected. Every kWh helps the climate.
text.Bu — real, o'lchanadigan ekologik ta'sir: This is a real, measurable environmental impact.
text.Hisob: har kVt·soat uchun 0,77 kg CO₂ va: Basis: 0.77 kg of CO₂ and 0.4 kg of coal per kWh. Baliqchi HPP figures are planned values after launch.
text.Baliqchi GES: bo'sh yerdan stansiyagacha: Baliqchi HPP: from an empty plot to a power plant
text.2025-yil maydan beri har bir bosqich sur: Every stage has been photographed since May 2025. That is how we work: everything open, everything documented.
text.Sug'orish kanali bo'yidagi uchastka o'rg: We surveyed a plot by the irrigation canal and measured the flow rate and height difference.
text.Xitoylik hamkor bilan uskuna yetkazib be: An equipment supply and construction contract was signed with the Chinese partner.
text.Jamoa va hamkorlar maydonga chiqdi, ucha: The team and partners moved onto the site, cleared the plot and set up temporary facilities.
text.Stansiya binosi uchun chuqur kotlovan qa: A deep pit was dug for the powerhouse; groundwater was pumped out around the clock.
text.Suv qabul qilgich va stansiya poydevori: Reinforcement for the intake and the powerhouse foundation was tied.
text.Stansiya poydevori va pastki qismi beton: The foundation and lower part of the powerhouse were concreted.
text.Xitoydan kelgan dastlabki uskunalar kran: The first equipment from China was lifted onto the site by crane.
text.Qishda ham to'xtamadik: kanal tubi va de: We did not stop in winter either: the channel bed and walls were concreted.
text.Stansiya binosining karkasi ko'tarildi,: The powerhouse frame went up and the waterways took shape.
text.Beton bilan qoplangan derivatsiya kanali: The concrete-lined derivation channel was fully completed.
text.Xitoy zavodida tayyorlangan g'ildirakli: Wheeled gates and an overhead crane made at a factory in China were delivered.
text.Ikki gorizontal turbina o'rnatilmoqda. I: Two horizontal turbines are being installed. Launch: end of October.
text.Qurilish jarayonidan haqiqiy suratlar: d: Real photos from construction: the derivation channel, the gates, the installation of two turbine units and the powerhouse.

text.GESga ikki yo'l bilan ega bo'lasiz: Two ways to own a hydropower plant
text.Yeringizda GES qurib beramiz: We build a plant on your land
text.Suv manbai bor yer yoki kanal bo'yidagi: We design, build, commission and hand over a plant on your plot by a river or canal. One team does everything, from measurements to service.
text.O'zimiz qurgan, hujjatlari rasmiylashtir: You can buy a plant we built, with all documents in order, as an income-generating asset. We will show you its performance on site.
text.Mutaxassis yeringizga chiqadi: suv sarfi: A specialist visits your site and measures the flow rate, flow speed and height difference.
text.Quvvat, yillik ishlab chiqarish va qopla: A feasibility study covering capacity, annual output and payback period.
text.Xitoylik hamkorlarimizdan turbina, gener: Turbines, generators and automatic control systems from our Chinese partners.
text.Suv qabul qilgich, derivatsiya kanali, s: Intake, derivation channel, powerhouse and electrical works.
text.Hujjatlar, kelishuvlar va elektr tarmog': Support with documents, approvals and connection to the power grid.
text.Sozlash, xodimlarni o'qitish va stansiya: Tuning, staff training and maintenance while the plant is running.
text.Qo'ng'iroqdan birinchi kilovattgacha: From the first call to the first kilowatt
text.Har bir bosqichda siz bilan bitta mas'ul: One dedicated manager works with you at every stage. Every step, deadline and price is agreed in advance.
text.Qo'ng'iroq qilasiz yoki Telegramga yozas: You call or message us on Telegram. We briefly discuss your water source, location and goals.
text.Mutaxassis obyektga borib suv sarfi va n: A specialist visits the site, measures the flow and head, and marks the route of the derivation channel and the plant location.
text.Quvvat, yillik ishlab chiqarish, loyiha: We provide a document with the capacity, annual output, project cost and payback period.
text.Shartnoma imzolanadi, ishchi loyiha tayy: The contract is signed, the detailed design is prepared and the equipment is ordered.
text.Derivatsiya kanalini qazish, stansiya bi: Digging the derivation channel, building the powerhouse, installing equipment, electrical works and grid connection.
text.Stansiya sinovdan o'tadi va topshiriladi: The plant is tested and handed over. We keep providing maintenance afterwards.
text.Suvingiz qancha tok berishini hisoblang: Calculate how much power your water can make
text.Ikkita qiymatni kiriting: suv sarfi va b: Enter two values: flow rate and height difference. The result is an estimate; we give the exact figure after a specialist measures on site.
text.1 000 so'm: bizning obyektlar hisobidagi: 1,000 UZS: the grid sale price used for our own plants. The others: what you save if you use the power yourself (het.uz household tariffs from 1 June 2026). You can also enter a price manually.
text.Hisobda: FIK η = 0,80 · yillik yuklama 9: Assumptions: efficiency η = 0.80 · annual load factor 90% (~99% at our plants) · household 2,200 kWh/year · CO₂ 0.77 kg/kWh · project cost $1,700–2,500/kW (our plants) · $1 ≈ 12,700 UZS
text.Shu hisob bilan murojaat qilish: Send an enquiry with this estimate
text.Mini-GES bozorida nima gap: What's happening in the small-hydro market
text.Mini-GES qurish uchun nima kerak?: What do I need to build a small hydropower plant?
text.Yil davomida oqadigan suv manbai (ko'pin: A year-round water source (most often an irrigation canal) and space next to it for a derivation channel. We dig a channel along the canal and create the height difference we need. A specialist will tell you after measuring whether your site is suitable.
text.Qancha quvvat olish mumkin?: How much power can I get?
text.Quvvat suv sarfi va naporga bog'liq: P =: Power depends on flow rate and head: P = 9.81 × Q × H × η. The calculator above gives an estimate; the exact value comes after on-site measurements.
text.Har bir obyekt alohida hisoblanadi: quvv: Every project is priced individually, depending on capacity, channel length, equipment type and the scope of construction. The feasibility study states the project cost and payback period in writing. As a guide: at our plants 1 kW of capacity cost about $1,700–2,500 (Ulug'nor HPP, 600 kW: $1 mln; Baliqchi HPP, 1,000 kW: $2.5 mln).
text.Ishlab chiqarilgan tokni nima qilaman?: What do I do with the power I generate?
text.O'z korxonangiz yoki xo'jaligingiz ehtiy: You can use it for your own business or farm, or sell it to the grid. We help with the grid-connection paperwork.
text.Suv kamaygan mavsumda nima bo'ladi?: What happens in the low-water season?
text.Mavsumiy o'zgarish hisob-kitobga oldinda: Seasonal changes are built into the calculation in advance. Annual output is estimated from the average flow, not the peak.
text.Ishga tushgandan keyin kim xizmat ko'rsa: Who services the plant after launch?
text.Biz. Stansiyani sozlaymiz, xodimlaringiz: We do. We tune the plant, train your staff and take care of maintenance from then on.
text.Suvingiz bekorga oqmasin: Don't let your water flow to waste
